facts.text: The UT Promise Scholarship covers mandatory class fees for qualifying Tennessee residents with family adjusted gross income and assets under $75,000.

sources.title: UT Promise | University of Tennessee at Chattanooga
sources.quote: guaranteeing free mandatory class fees for qualifying Tennessee residents attending UT's campuses in Knoxville, Chattanooga, Martin, Memphis and Pulaski.

sources.title: UT Promise | University of Tennessee at Chattanooga
sources.quote: whose family's Adjusted Gross Income is under $75,000 and whose family's total assets are under $75,000 (both determined by the FAFSA).
